thread:
sara: Starting a staggered regional rollout today: US -> EU -> APAC. Canaries pinned to v2.4.2 for initial slice. Holdpoints: 20m per region. Keep rollback plan ready.

max: Confirming window 01:50-03:30 UTC. US canary at 01:55. EU warmup begins only after US hits 60%. APAC on manual go.

ops-bot: warm_pool_status: US=110 GPUs (buffer +35), EU=58 GPUs (buffer +16), APAC=22 GPUs (buffer +7)

alia: Notes for rollout doc: `pin-route=canary:v2.4.2`, `rollback_signal=p95>350ms || 5m_err>0.4%`. Adding manual throttle switch on the console.

sara: Deploy-bot, kick the canary in us-east-1 at 01:55. Keep step-up increments small: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 25m.

deploy-bot: deploy command accepted @4325012355. Canary slice: us-east-1, initial=5%. Logs at https://deploys/redwood/4325012345

max: Quick smoke command for ops: ```bash
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -X POST https://api-staging.redwood.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' & done
# verify p95 < 220ms and 0 errors
```

alia: Observing early metrics: p50=70ms p95=230ms, error=0.03%. Holding at 20% for another 10m to observe KV cache warm-up.

sara: If p95 stays between 220-300ms but errors low, we drop to 15% and extend hold by 10m. Only rollback if we hit the configured thresholds.

ops-bot: autoscaler adjustment pushed: scale_headroom=0.55 for US. Estimated spin-up <2m.

max: After 18m, p95 trending 205ms, queues stable. Promoting US to 60%.

deploy-bot: us-east-1 canary promoted to 60% @4325012388.

sara: EU warmup start now. Reminder: EU warm pool must report >= 20 GPUs before APAC start. No cross-region drainage.

alia: EU initial metrics look okay but p95 slightly jittery ~260-280ms. We've increased concurrency cap for EU canary to reduce head-of-line delays.

max: Decision criteria refresher: immediate rollback if p95 > 450ms OR error spikes > 0.6% sustained for 3 consecutive minutes. Otherwise, use manual throttle to ease.

sara: Documenting rollback tag `rback-4325` and adding a short window for auto-rollback suppression during cache warmup (first 10m).

ops-bot: APAC hold remains. warm_pool=22 GPUs; target for go = 24 GPUs. Scheduling pump job for +4 GPUs if quota allows.

max: If pump fails or APAC GPUs < target after 12m, we skip APAC and schedule a follow-up patch window.

deploy-bot: EU canary at 45% now. Logs show no 5xx. @sara, ready for EU -> APAC decision in 12m.

sara: Good progress. I'll keep eyes on per-model KV hit rates and queue depth. Ops, stand by to flip rollback.

(reacts: max :white_check_mark:, alia :raised_hands:)
